cleanIntro: Ruger's own field strip for the Security-9, ten steps, ending exactly where the manual ends.

steps.title: Magazine out first
steps.action: Keep the pistol pointed in a safe direction, press the magazine latch and withdraw the magazine from the frame.
steps.prose: Feeding source before chamber, in that order, every time.
steps.quote: Keep pistol pointed in a safe direction. Press the magazine latch and withdraw the magazine from the frame
steps.cite: Ruger Security-9 Instruction Manual — PM1184 — Disassembly, step 1, p.21
steps.warn: Always unload a firearm before cleaning, lubrication, disassembly, or assembly.

steps.title: Lock the slide back
steps.action: Pull the slide to the rear and lock it open by pushing upward on the slide stop.
steps.prose: Unlike the LCP, this one has a proper slide stop — push it up while the slide is held back.
steps.quote: and lock it in the open
steps.cite: Ruger Security-9 Instruction Manual — PM1184 — Disassembly, step 2, p.21

steps.title: Verify the chamber
steps.action: Inspect the chamber and verify that it is empty.
steps.prose: Look, and then look again with a finger. Empty means empty by sight and by feel.
steps.quote: Inspect the chamber and verify that it is empty
steps.cite: Ruger Security-9 Instruction Manual — PM1184 — Disassembly, step 3, p.22

steps.title: Let the slide run forward
steps.action: Retract the slide slightly and release it.
steps.prose: That short pull is what drops the slide stop back out of the way.
steps.quote: This will disengage the slide stop and allow the slide to move fully forward.
steps.cite: Ruger Security-9 Instruction Manual — PM1184 — Disassembly, step 4, p.22

steps.title: Line it up, then pry the takedown pin
steps.action: Retract the slide about 1/16 inch so the front of the slide aligns with the front of the grip frame, then pry the takedown pin loose with a non-marring armorer’s tool or other flat, blunt tool.
steps.prose: The alignment is the whole trick — the pin will not move until those two faces line up.
steps.caution: Be careful not to scratch the slide.
steps.quote: Retract the slide approximately 1/16" so the front of the slide aligns with the front of the grip frame.
steps.cite: Ruger Security-9 Instruction Manual — PM1184 — Disassembly, step 5, p.22

steps.title: Takedown pin out
steps.prose: All the way out, and somewhere it cannot roll.
steps.cite: Ruger Security-9 Instruction Manual — PM1184 — Disassembly, step 6, p.23

steps.title: Slide assembly off
steps.action: Move the slide assembly forward and separate it from the grip frame.
steps.quote: Move the slide assembly forward and separate it from the grip frame
steps.cite: Ruger Security-9 Instruction Manual — PM1184 — Disassembly, step 7, p.23

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly out
steps.action: Compress the recoil spring assembly slightly to disengage it from its seat against the barrel lug, then remove it completely.
steps.prose: It is under tension against the lug. Control it out rather than letting it jump.
steps.caution: Spring under tension. Keep it pointed away from your face.
steps.quote: Compress the recoil spring assembly slightly to disengage it from its seat against the barrel lug, and remove it completely
steps.cite: Ruger Security-9 Instruction Manual — PM1184 — Disassembly, step 8, p.24

steps.title: Barrel out
steps.action: Move the barrel forward slightly, then down and back, to extract it from the slide.
steps.prose: Forward, down, back. Straight rearward will bind on the lug.
steps.quote: It will be necessary to move the barrel forward slightly and then down and back to extract it from the slide
steps.cite: Ruger Security-9 Instruction Manual — PM1184 — Disassembly, step 9, p.24

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: Frame, slide, barrel, recoil spring assembly, magazine. That is the whole strip Ruger publishes.
steps.prose: The manual stops here, and so does this guide.
steps.quote: The pistol is now disassembled for cleaning
steps.cite: Ruger Security-9 Instruction Manual — PM1184 — Disassembly, step 10, p.24

deepAbsentReason: The Security-9 manual ends its disassembly at step 10, "The pistol is now disassembled for cleaning" (p.24), and documents nothing past the field strip. This listing therefore has NO deep clean.
reassembly: Be certain the chamber and magazine are empty.
Replace the barrel in the slide, then seat the recoil spring assembly against the barrel lug.
Run the slide assembly onto the grip frame and reinstall the takedown pin.
fncheck: Function-check per the manual, pointed in a safe direction with the pistol and magazine confirmed empty.
